name: AI Lead Generation Automation
description: 100% free-tier B2B lead qualification engine. Scans free open job/signal feeds (Arbeitnow, Jobicy, RemoteOK, Hacker News), keyword-scores for automation pain, filters duplicates against your CRM, runs a dual-stage Gemini qualification (a primary qualifier, then a deliberately skeptical auditor with veto power), and saves only approved leads.

nodes.name: Fetch RemoteOK Free Feed
nodes.notes: Public API, no credential needed. Send a User-Agent header or RemoteOK blocks the request

nodes.name: Fetch HN Automation Pain Signals
nodes.notes: HN Algolia search, public, no credential needed

nodes.name: Fetch HN Manual Process Signals
nodes.notes: HN Algolia search, public, no credential needed

nodes.name: Normalize & Signal Scoring
nodes.notes: Normalizes all feed shapes into a common lead schema and keyword-scores each item across 9 automation-pain signal groups

nodes.name: Filter Duplicates & Enterprises
nodes.notes: Drops known enterprise domains and anything already in the CRM by URL or company name

nodes.name: Primary Gemini AI Qualification
nodes.notes: Requires a Google Gemini API credential. Scores each lead 0-100 against a detailed rubric and returns qualified/lead_score/buying_intent/etc

nodes.name: Parse & Validate Primary AI JSON
nodes.notes: Parses/repairs the AI's JSON output with sane fallbacks on malformed output

nodes.name: Check Qualification Gate
nodes.notes: qualified=true AND lead_score>=70 AND target_fit != REJECT AND ai_parse_status=SUCCESS

nodes.name: Skeptical AI Validator
nodes.notes: A second, deliberately skeptical Gemini pass with hard veto power over the primary qualification

nodes.name: Check Validation Gate
nodes.notes: Passes only if the skeptical auditor's audit_pass/approved flag is true

nodes.name: Format & Enrich Lead for CRM
nodes.notes: Merges both AI passes into final score/priority/temperature and maps to your Airtable field IDs

meta.setup_notes: Requires: a Google Gemini API credential and an Airtable credential. The 5 fetch nodes hit public, free, no-auth APIs. Replace all YOUR_* placeholders before use.
